newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpharma cut by Cowen.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alpharma cut by Cowen.

text.p: -- Alpharma Inc was cut by Cowen & Co to a neutral from its prior rating of buy, according to Cowen.

-- Cowen cut its 1996 profit estimate for Alpharma by $0.37 a share to $0.58 a share for the 1996 year. It cut 1997 earnings per share estimate to $1.00 from $1.25. 1998 annual earnings estimate was cut to $1.35 a share from $1.55.
-- Shares fell 3-3/4 to 11-1/8. They hit a new intraday low of 10-3/4.
